zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。
en: We need to {check in} two hours before the flight.

zh: 我们得在十点前退房。
en: We have to {check out of|leave} the hotel by ten.

zh: 飞机晚了四十分钟才起飞。
en: The plane {took off|left|departed} forty minutes late.

zh: 周日你能去机场接我父母吗？
en: Can you {pick up|collect|get|fetch|meet} my parents from the airport on Sunday?

zh: 出租车司机把我们的行李送到了错的酒店。
en: The taxi driver {dropped off|dropped|left} our bags at the wrong hotel.

zh: 今天早上我们六点就出发了，好避开堵车。
en: This morning we {set off|left|headed off|set out|took off|headed out} at six to beat the traffic.

zh: 我们上错了公交车，结果到了新市场。
en: We {got on|caught|took|hopped on|jumped on|boarded} the wrong bus and ended up in Newmarket.

zh: 你得在下一站下车。
en: You need to {get off|hop off|get out|jump off} at the next stop.

zh: 我特别期待我们的皇后镇之旅。
en: I'm really {looking forward to|excited about} our trip to Queenstown.

zh: 我们希望复活节能出去玩几天。
en: We're hoping to {get away|go away|escape|travel} for a few days over Easter.

zh: 去伦敦的路上，我们在新加坡中途停留了一晚。
en: We {stopped over|stayed|stopped|stopped off} in Singapore for a night on the way to London.

zh: 我们在海关被耽搁了一个小时。
en: We were {held up|delayed|stuck|stopped|kept} at customs for an hour.

zh: 我们周日晚上回奥克兰。
en: We're {heading back|going back|coming back|flying back|driving back|returning|heading} to Auckland on Sunday night.

zh: 在惠灵顿没有车出行也很方便。
en: It's easy to {get around|get round|travel around|go around} Wellington without a car.

zh: 司机靠边停了车，让救护车过去。
en: The driver {pulled over|pulled in|stopped|moved over} to let the ambulance pass.

zh: 出城之前我们先把油加满吧，越往南油越贵。
en: Let's {fill up|refuel|top up|gas up} before we leave town. Petrol costs more further south.

zh: 我们租的车在去陶波的半路上抛锚了。
en: Our rental car {broke down|died|stopped} halfway to Taupo.

zh: 我们午夜刚过就降落在了基督城。
en: We {touched down|landed|arrived} in Christchurch just after midnight.

zh: 因为订满了，我们没赶上萤火虫洞之旅。
en: We {missed out on|missed} the glow-worm tour because it was fully booked.

zh: 上飞机前我们挤出时间去了一趟霍比屯。
en: We {squeezed in|fitted in|fit in|managed} a quick trip to Hobbiton before our flight.
